senses.gloss: मुह vi. 4P (pp. मूढ or मुग्ध; pres. मुह्यति) 1. To faint, to lose consciousness, स शुश्रुवांस्तद्वचनं मुमोह Bt.i.20; 2. to be bewildered, to lose presence of mind; 3. to err, to mistake; 4. to be foolish.With प्र-, to be infatuated, to be stupefied.With वि-, 1. to be perplexed, to be confused, to be embarrassed, नैनां प्राप्य विमुह्यति Bg.ii.72; 2. to be foolish.With सम्-, to be foolish, to be ignorant.
मुह Caus. (मोहयति-ते) to infatuate, मामूमुहत्खलु भवंतमनन्यजन्मा M.M.i.With परि-, (Atm.) to allure, to beguile, Bt.viii.63.
मुहिर (II) m. 1. The god of love; 2. a fool, a blockhead.

मुहुस् ind. 1. Repeatedly, constantly, श्वसन् मुहुः फणी मयूरस्य तले निषीदति Rt.i.13; 2. for a moment, for a time, अस्त्रैस्तावन्मुहुरुपचितैर्दृष्टिरालुप्यते मे Megh.ii.42.(मुहुस्-मुहुस् ‘at one time-at another time,’ मुहुर्भ्रश्यद्बीजा मुहुरपि बहुप्रापितफला (नीतिः) Mud.v. मुहुर्मुहुस् ‘repeatedly, over and over again,’ मुहुर्मुहुर्जृंभणतत्पराणि Rt.vi.10.)
मुहूर्त (I) m.n. 1. Any short space of time, a moment, स्थित्वा तस्मिन् वनचरवधूभुक्तकुंजे मुहूर्तम् Megh.i.19, R.iii.53, K.S.vii.50; 2. a period of 48 minutes.
मुहूर्तक m.n. 1. A moment, an instant; 2. a period of 48 minutes.
